dimensions.assessment: Directly affects specialty crop growers, wine producers, and potentially participants in federal nutrition assistance programs.
dimensions.evidence: direct payments for covered losses, and distribute such payments, to the following persons: (A) Specialty crop growers. (B) Wine producers.

dimensions.assessment: Provides direct financial assistance and crop purchasing options to offset economic losses caused by increased foreign tariffs.
dimensions.evidence: economic loss due to reduced market access; (v) reduced contracts with a foreign buyer

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes necessary appropriations for fiscal years 2026 through 2030 and allows up to 1 percent of funds for administrative costs.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary such sums as are necessary to carry out this section for fiscal years 2026 through 2030.

dimensions.assessment: Creates a new USDA program modeled after existing statutory authorities and mandates regular reporting to Congress.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of Agriculture shall establish a program to make direct payments

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations and reporting requirements running through fiscal year 2030.
dimensions.evidence: annually thereafter until 2030, the Secretary shall provide to Congress a report

importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes a direct payment program through the Department of Agriculture for specialty crop growers and wine producers experiencing tariff-related losses, and authorizes surplus crop purchases.
